name: Seppa
description: District headquarters of East Kameng, situated on the banks of the Kameng River at about 363 m elevation. Scenic valley town with riverside views, local Nyishi markets, and a base for exploring the three valleys and nearby hill stations. Formerly known as Sepla meaning marshy land.
facts: Helipad in the heart of town

name: Bomdila
description: District headquarters of West Kameng and a scenic hill station at about 2,415 m elevation. Known for Buddhist monasteries (GRL complex), apple orchards, craft centres, and panoramic Himalayan views. Major stop on the Tezpur-Tawang highway.

name: Bomdila Monastery (GRL)
description: Gentse Gaden Rabgyel Ling (GRL) Monastery complex in Bomdila, with Upper and Lower Gompas. Major Buddhist centre with prayer halls, murals, and schools for monks; offers views over the town and valleys.
facts: Official tourist place of the district

name: Dirang
description: Scenic valley town in West Kameng on NH-13, known for hot springs, Dirang Dzong, orchards, and as a base for Sangti Valley and Tawang route. Proposed geothermal-powered town.
facts: Gateway to Sela Pass and Tawang

name: Dirang Hot Springs
description: Natural geothermal hot springs near Dirang town, popular for mineral-rich therapeutic baths amid Himalayan scenery. A key attraction for visitors on the western Arunachal circuit.
facts: Part of official places of interest

name: Sangti Valley
description: Picturesque high valley about 14 km from Dirang, surrounded by Himalayan ranges, orchards, and forests. Famous wintering site for black-necked cranes and ideal for nature walks and photography.

name: Thembang Fortified Village
description: Ancient Monpa fortified village with traditional stone Dzong walls and two historic gates. UNESCO tentative World Heritage site (2014) for its cultural landscape, living heritage, and community conservation practices. About 55 km from Bomdila.

name: Eaglenest Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Biodiversity hotspot sanctuary in West Kameng spanning 218 sq km, elevation 500-3,250 m. Home to red pandas, over 450 bird species, rare orchids, and part of Kameng Elephant Reserve. Adjacent to Sessa Orchid Sanctuary.
facts: Part of Kameng Protected Area Complex

name: Sessa Orchid Sanctuary
description: 100 sq km protected area in West Kameng focused on orchid diversity in Himalayan foothills. Conjoins Eaglenest WLS; part of Kameng Elephant Reserve with rich temperate and subtropical forests.

name: Tippi Orchid Research Centre
description: Orchid research and display centre at Tippi (near Bhalukpong) on the banks of the Kameng River. Features a glass house with thousands of orchids, tissue culture lab, and gardens; about 65 km from Tezpur.
facts: Official tourist place of West Kameng

name: Nyukmadong War Memorial
description: War memorial commemorating the 1962 Sino-Indian War Battle of Nyukmadong (18 Nov 1962). Features a chorten-style memorial, plaques of fallen soldiers, and terraced landscaping overlooking the battlefield on NH-13.

name: Bhalukpong
description: Gateway town and entry point to Arunachal Pradesh from Assam (near Tezpur). Located at the foothills with ruins, river access, and as the starting point for the climb to Bomdila and Tawang.

name: Mandala Top
description: High viewpoint near Bomdila famous for 108 Buddhist stupas and panoramic sunrise/sunset views over the Himalayan ranges and valleys.

name: Chillipam Monastery
description: Secluded Buddhist monastery (also Sangngag Choekhor Dargyeling / Zangdokpalri) about 15 km from Rupa, built on a promontory with 270-degree Himalayan valley views and rich Buddhist art.

name: Lhagyala Gompa
description: Monastery situated on the mountainside overlooking the Morshing valley, about 80 km from Bomdila. Important spiritual site for the local Monpa community.

name: Shergaon
description: Offbeat village and horticulture area in West Kameng with apple orchards, state farm, and traditional settlements. Known for quieter rural Himalayan experience near the main circuit.
